record.one_liner: Ahrefs SEO platform: keyword, backlink, rank and site data via REST API v3 and a hosted MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API v3 uses a Bearer API key created in Account settings / API keys; MCP uses a separate generated MCP key.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed paid_plan. API v3 needs Lite or higher; other plans (incl. Ahrefs Free) only get a limited set of free test queries, not working credentials for real use. No trial path to the API found.
record.api_notes: REST API v3 with many Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer and other endpoints; API units consumed per row. Some endpoints are free.
record.blocker_notes: Real API and MCP use needs a Lite or higher paid subscription.

evidence.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans.
On all other plans, you'll still have access to a limited set of free test queries.
Using API v3 from any of the above methods is possible for Lite and higher subscription plans
